proposals.what: RFC 3.2.1 L114: 'Every entry of a list node is an item, and every item MUST carry these common fields:' -> 'Every entry of an item node (`objectives`, `assumptions`, `decisions`, `ambiguities`, `deviations`, `observations`, `operational_learning`, `proposals`, `rfis`) is an item, and every item MUST carry these common fields (S-18 lists what an item in a brief or an AAR may omit):'. And in 3.3.3: 'constraints[]  what the delegate must not do or cannot use: text + source' -> 'constraints[]  {text, source} objects (not items): what the delegate must not do or cannot use'; 'rules[] ...' -> 'rules[]  absolute paths (strings): every file to read in full ...'
proposals.why: OBS-1: the rule as written makes every brief invalid; the briefs already written use the narrower shapes
proposals.barrier_analysis: Stops the WP-1 schema author choosing between a validator that rejects all briefs and a schema that contradicts the RFC

proposals.what: RFC 3.6.10 L403: 'The existing verbs (`observation add`, `ol add`, `decision add`, `log`, `knowledge add`) MUST keep working and write `items` rows.' -> 'The existing session-DB verbs MUST keep working: `observation add` and `ol add` write `items` rows; `incident add` writes `deviation` items (`from.kind` `plan`); `decision add` writes `decision` items. `log` (SITREP, SPOTREP) keeps writing `messages`, and `directive add` keeps writing `commander_directives`. The harness-DB verbs (`knowledge`, `edge`, `nogood`) are unchanged.' Add to the 3.6.7 table: '| rows of the v4 `decisions` table | items of type `decision` (`decision_id` -> `id`, `title` -> `text`, `description`, `implementation_evidence`, `decided_at`, `implemented_at` -> `fields`) |'
